newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma started as a buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said it initiated coverage of Brazilian brewery Brahma with a buy recommendation.
-- "We rate Brahma a long-term buy on the grounds that the company is well positioned financially, generating significant cash flows, and well managed," it said in a report.

-- It said that, although the shares have risen steadily over the last two years, it believes Brahma continues to represent good value as a consumer play in the largest market for beverages in Latin America.
-- Brahma common shares traded at 637 reais, off 0.46 percent, while its preferred stock was quoted at 625 reais, off 0.47 percent, at 1127 local/1427 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
